title: The 2.7% Rule for Retirement Spending
summary: Ben Felix examines whether the well-known 4% retirement withdrawal rule holds up, drawing on academic papers. He argues that a safe rate may be closer to 2.7%, especially for early retirees.
why: HN cites it as the source for the argument that safe withdrawal rates should be lower than 4%.

quote.text: For early retirees, Ben Felix has found the SWR to be closer to 2.7%.
